notes.title: We are releasing our new game Helping the Hotties
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Long time since the last time you heard from us. We've been working on our new game that will be coming out on Thursday 31st of August. We've introduced many improvements in all the aspects, from story, render quality, Voice Acting to overall content quantity. And yeah, you're first to know that we will be also translating Hotties to different languages. 

Can't wait to share with you the final update! Go check it out on the link below.

P.S. We will also have a little discount so Wishlist the game now so you get notified once the game is out and on discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590730

notes.title: Lewd Island is part of the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.content:
Lewd Island tells a complete story and with a bunch of improvements made to gameplay, sound and UI, now is the best time to find out the mysteries of the island, accompanied by your beautiful female companion.  
How did you really end up on this island? Was there anybody else here before?

Full walkthrough, explaining how every choice affects the story and how to unlock every Steam achievement is also included with the game!
Winter is best spent on Lewd Island!

As a part of the Winter sale, you can get answers to all the questions with a discount. 
You can save even more if you buy in a bundle with our other game, Helping the Hotties!

notes.title: FREE DLC Official Walkthrough and Lewd Island at Steam Autumn Sale!
notes.content:
With Lewd Island’s story completed and a bunch of improvements made to gameplay, sound and UI, it has never been a better opportunity to find out how you’ve ended up on that island with your beautiful female companion.  


Why can’t you remember your past? How did you end up on this island? 

As a part of the Autumn Sale, you can get answers to all the questions with a disscount.

notes.title: Wishlist Now: Red Falls Season 1 Early Acess
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kSuzhGNn-2w;full][/previewyoutube]

Game Info:
You are a college student madly in love with your girlfriend, but instead of spending summer with her, you receive an unexpected phone call. Next day you’re on a bus going to work in a boys educational and misbehavior camp, but to your surprise it’s not boys camp anymore…

Red Falls is currently in EARLY ACCESS and only Episode 1 is available.
Currently available content: Red Falls Episode 1
- 1000+ IMAGES
- 50 ANIMATIONS
- 8 HOT Female characters

Gameplay:
- Free roam
- Time Cycle
- In-game Hint system
- Define the relationships within the game
- Change angle of animations

Development info:
Red Falls Season 1 is planned to have a total of 5 episodes.
Episode 2 is in development...

Planed content and features for Season 1(All 5 Episodes):
- 10.000 images
- 300+ animations
- FULL VOICE-OVER (for all female characters)
- Interactive sex scenes
- Gallery
- Change angle of images
- Nude mode renders (x-ray vision)
- Steam Achievements
- Trading cards

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590730/Red_Falls_Season_1/?beta=0
